# TypeScript Monorepo Starter — Route Map

This repository is a TypeScript monorepo. Use this map to find your way around.

## Conventions and rules

- /CLAUDE.md            — Project memory, conventions, restrictions
- /AGENTS.md            — Cross-vendor agent guidance (mirrors CLAUDE.md)
- /SECURITY.md          — Security policy, AI tooling disclosure

## Packages

- /packages/shared/     — Shared library (utilities, types). Leaf package.
- /packages/api/        — Example API service.

Each package has its own AGENTS.md describing its purpose and entry points.

## Build and verify

- /package.json         — Root config, npm workspaces, verify script
- /tsconfig.base.json   — Base TS config inherited by packages
- /scripts/verify.sh    — Verify runner (lint + typecheck + format + test)

## Harness (Claude Code)

- /.claude/settings.json — Hooks wiring
- /.claude/skills/       — Reusable skill playbooks
- /.claude/agents/       — Subagent roster (planner, reviewer, test-writer)
- /.claude/hooks/        — Bash firewall, protected paths, post-edit format

## CI and PR

- /.github/workflows/verify.yml      — CI pipeline
- /.github/pull_request_template.md  — PR template with AI authorship tags
- /.github/CODEOWNERS                — Review routing
